newsitem.title: USA: New York Times October advertising up.
newsitem.headline: New York Times October advertising up.

text.p: The New York Times Co said Friday its total advertising volume for its New York Times newspaper rose 1.6 percent in October, though year-to-date advertising inches were down 1.6 percent for the month.
The company reported its Boston Globe saw total advertising volume up 0.7 percent in October, though it was down 0.4 percent for the year to date.
The company's Regional Newspaper Group reported total advertising volume up 6.1 percent for October and up 0.3 percent for the year to date.
